en: The image is a sepia-toned postcard showing a lakeside scene with a forested ridge (Pyynikki) in the background. There are several people on the rocky shore, some standing close to the water, and a few buildings and piers visible on the far shore. The upper right corner contains printed text reading 'Pyynikki — Tampere.' The atmosphere and clothing suggest an early 20th-century period.
